subject: player
when: (() => { const terms = player.get('before.questTerms') ?? [], now = player.get('questTerms') ?? []; const gone = quest => !now.some(match => match.type === quest.type && match.condition === quest.condition); const lost = deadline => deadline > turn && (terms.some(quest => quest.deadline === deadline) ? terms.some(quest => quest.deadline === deadline && gone(quest)) : !player.questDeadlines.includes(deadline)); return player.before.questDeadlines.some(lost); })()

values.previousDeadline: (() => { const terms = player.get('before.questTerms') ?? [], now = player.get('questTerms') ?? []; const gone = quest => !now.some(match => match.type === quest.type && match.condition === quest.condition); const lost = deadline => deadline > turn && (terms.some(quest => quest.deadline === deadline) ? terms.some(quest => quest.deadline === deadline && gone(quest)) : !player.questDeadlines.includes(deadline)); return Math.min(...player.before.questDeadlines.filter(lost)); })()
values.questIndex: (() => { const terms = player.get('before.questTerms') ?? [], now = player.get('questTerms') ?? []; const gone = quest => !now.some(match => match.type === quest.type && match.condition === quest.condition); const matches = quest => quest.deadline === previousDeadline && gone(quest); const rewarded = terms.findIndex(quest => matches(quest) && quest.get('reward')); return rewarded >= 0 ? rewarded : terms.findIndex(matches); })()
values.questTermsLine: questCondition ? ' The listing read: ' + questCondition + (questReward ? ' Potential reward: ' + questReward + '.' : '') : ''

subject: player
when: player.questDeadlines.some(deadline => Number.isSafeInteger(deadline) && deadline >= turn && deadline <= turn + 3)

values.questDeadline: (() => { return Math.min(...player.questDeadlines.filter(deadline => Number.isSafeInteger(deadline) && deadline >= turn && deadline <= turn + 3)); })()
values.questIndex: (() => { if (!player.knows('questTerms')) return -1; const terms = player.questTerms; const matches = quest => quest.deadline === questDeadline; const rewarded = terms.findIndex(quest => matches(quest) && quest.knows('reward')); return rewarded >= 0 ? rewarded : terms.findIndex(matches); })()
